zh.title: 巴基斯坦Khuzdar：Kuraro附近RCD公路遭武装封控并有商用车辆被焚
zh.summary: 11月19日地方媒体报道，武装人员在Khuzdar的Kuraro附近设置检查点，RCD公路交通受阻数小时，商用车辆据称被焚。
zh.body: 事实：The Balochistan Post于11月19日报道，武装人员在Khuzdar的Kuraro附近RCD公路设置检查点并搜查车辆，交通据称中断数小时；报道还称接近现场的巴方部队遭伏击，多辆商用车辆被焚，行政部门曾提醒司机避开路段。分析：临时武装路障通过车辆损失、承运商拒载和运输延误影响企业物流，既可能是展示地区行动自由，也可能属于局部短时袭扰。Khuzdar事件与Chagai矿点袭击按不同事件记录。管理决策：逐车核对司机、货物及位置，暂缓向Kuraro受影响路段发车，待当地实际通行恢复后重新排班。指标：恢复通车时间、车辆损失、责任声明及同路段重复封控。核实等级：单一地方媒体报道，待独立核实。来源：https://thebalochistanpost.net/2026/11/armed-men-attack-mining-site-in-chagai-and-block-highway-in-khuzdar/

en.title: Pakistan Khuzdar: Armed blockade reported on RCD Highway near Kuraro with commercial vehicles burned
en.summary: A local report dated 19 November describes armed checkpoints near Kuraro, several hours of disruption to the RCD Highway and commercial vehicles reportedly set on fire.
en.body: Facts: The Balochistan Post reported on 19 November that armed men erected checkpoints and searched vehicles on the RCD Highway near Kuraro in Khuzdar. Traffic was reportedly blocked for several hours, approaching Pakistani forces were reportedly ambushed and several commercial vehicles burned. Local administrators reportedly advised motorists to avoid the affected section. Assessment: Temporary road control affects freight through vehicle losses, carrier refusal and delays. It may signal a challenge to government transport control or a shorter localized raid. This is a distinct event from the Chagai mining-site seizure. Management: Reconcile drivers, shipments and vehicles, hold departures to the affected road section, and resume after verified local reopening. Indicators: Reopening, cargo and vehicle losses, responsibility claims and repeated roadblocks. Verification: single local-media report pending independent confirmation. Source: https://thebalochistanpost.net/2026/11/armed-men-attack-mining-site-in-chagai-and-block-highway-in-khuzdar/
